summary_1line: Bhishma instructs Yudhishthira on royal duty: honor Brahmanas yet restrain offenders, balance mercy and severity, maintain authority, discipline servants, and act decisively in governance and war.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged Bhishma lying on a bed of arrows instructs the attentive king Yudhishthira on the duties of a ruler.
A stern king banishes a guilty Brahmana from the gates of his kingdom while courtiers watch in tense silence.
Disrespectful palace servants laugh and sprawl around the court while a too‑lenient king sits powerless on his throne.
